answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Dawah & Tableeg Question ID: 12168 Country: India Title: AssalamuAlaikum, I am married to a doctor.My problem is that my husband cares for other women more. He talks with other na maharam women over phone and when I ask about it, he says they are friend.Even I have requested him not to do so, but still he talks.I feel that such many effects of so called "modernism" in him. How can I bring towards sincerity and Deen. Please guide me. Question: AssalamuAlaikum, I am married to a doctor.My problem is that my husband cares for other women more. He talks with other na maharam women over phone and when I ask about it, he says they are friend.Even I have requested him not to do so, but still he talks.I feel that such many effects of so called "modernism" in him. How can I bring towards sincerity and Deen. Please guide me. Answer ID: 12168 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 653/653=M/1430) Keep on convincing your husband with politeness and wisdom that talking to non- mahram women is unlawful in Islam. Only by being friend, they will not be mahram for each other, rather they are more emphatically asked to observe purdah since it makes involvement in sin more probable. Such a modernity which contradicts to the Islamic Shariah is unacceptable in Islam. Also, you should pray to Allah for your husband to guide him. Recite ya Lateef and ya Wadood after Isha 111 times with durood 11 times before and after. In-shaAllah, he will love you and will abandon caring for the other women. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
